AdminChanged(address,address).details: Emitted when the admin account has changed.

BeaconUpgraded(address).details: Emitted when the beacon is changed.

Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

Upgraded(address).details: Emitted when the implementation is upgraded.

addPauseGuardians(address[]).details: This function can only be called by the contract owner. It delegates the addition of a new pause guardian to the PauseManager. require Caller must be the contract owner.

params.guardians: List Addresses of the accounts to be added as a pause guardian.

confirmTransferOwnership().details: This is real transfer ownership in second step by appointed account

getImplementation().details: The function returns the value stored in the implementation storage slot.

returns._0: The address of the implementation contract.

getLiquidityPoolBalance().details: Liquidity Pool balance not take into account following balances: collateral, ipor publication fee, treasury

getVersion().details: This function provides a way to access the version information of the contract. Currently, the version is set to 1.

returns._0: The version number of the contract.

isPauseGuardian(address).details: This function queries the PauseManager to determine if the provided account is a pause guardian.

returns._0: A boolean indicating whether the provided account is a pause guardian.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pause().details: This function can only be called by the pause guardian. It revokes the approval of stEth tokens for the router and then pauses the contract. require Caller must be the pause guardian.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

removePauseGuardians(address[]).details: This function can only be called by the contract owner. It delegates the removal of a pause guardian to the PauseManager. require Caller must be the contract owner.

params.guardians: List addresses of the accounts to be removed as a pause guardian.

unpause().details: This function can only be called by the contract owner. It unpauses the contract and then forcefully sets the approval of stEth tokens for the router to the maximum possible value. require Caller must be the contract owner.

upgradeTo(address).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

CallerNotPauseGuardian(string,address).notice: Error when caller is not a pause guardian

AppointedToTransferOwnership(address).notice: Emitted when account is appointed to transfer ownership

PauseGuardiansAdded(address[]).notice: Emitted when new pause guardian is added

PauseGuardiansRemoved(address[]).notice: Emitted when pause guardian is removed

addPauseGuardians(address[]).notice: Adds a new pause guardian to the contract.

getImplementation().notice: Retrieves the address of the implementation contract for UUPS proxy.

getLiquidityPoolBalance().notice: Gets the balance of the liquidity pool.

getVersion().notice: Retrieves the version number of the contract.

isPauseGuardian(address).notice: Checks if the given account is a pause guardian.

pause().notice: Pauses the contract and revokes the approval of stEth tokens for the router.

removePauseGuardians(address[]).notice: Removes an existing pause guardian from the contract.

unpause().notice: Unpauses the contract and forcefully approves the router to transfer an unlimited amount of stEth tokens.
